small_guidance: Reorder loops to put the IC reduction as the outermost accumulator over (kd,kh,kw): hoist x_base/w_base computation, and use larger BLOCK_K=IC=16 in a single iteration to drop inner-loop overhead. Also reduce register pressure (currently 168 reg/thread limiting occupancy to 25%) by using BLOCK_M=32,BLOCK_N=32,BLOCK_K=16 with num_warps=4, allow_tf32=True, and num_stages=3. Add @triton.autotune over {(32,32,16),(64,32,16),(32,64,16),(64,64,16)} keyed on (OC,SPATIAL,IC*KD*KH*KW).
large_guidance: Redesign as a scatter-add ConvTranspose3d: one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) that loads x[n,ic,id,ih,iw] and the (KD*KH*KW, OC) weight slice, computes the outer product, and atomically scatter-adds into the OC×(stride-expanded) output grid. This avoids the highly-masked gather where most (kd,kh,kw) positions are invalid (stride=2 means ~7/8 of gather lanes are masked off), reduces wasted work by 8x, and matches the natural data flow of ConvTranspose. Fuse the BN affine (folded scale/shift from running stats) and partial spatial-sum accumulation into the same kernel epilogue so the BN cudnn launch and the separate sum reduction disappear; finish with one small mean-subtract kernel.
